title: CTCL / MF-SS Staging Algorithm (TNMB)
subtitle: MF/Sézary TNMB stage grouping; complete T, N, M and B assessment is required

steps.prompt: Are T, N, M and B categories adequately established?
steps.detail: Use the applicable ISCL/EORTC definitions and clinical evaluation. This teaching tree is not a diagnostic test for lymphoma.
Complete the missing compartment assessment. Do not substitute normal blood, nodes or viscera for unavailable information.
N3 denotes frank nodal involvement with partial or complete architectural effacement (Dutch grade 3–4 / NCI LN4). There is no TNMB N4 category.

steps.prompt: Is there high blood tumor burden (B2)?
steps.detail: Modern flow-based assessment uses absolute abnormal T-cell counts with clonal assessment, not a CD4:CD8 ratio alone. B2 does not independently establish the clinical diagnosis of Sézary syndrome.

steps.prompt: T4: confluent erythema involving at least 80% BSA?
In T4 N0–N2 M0 disease, is blood B0 or B1?
T3: one or more tumors at least 1 cm in diameter?
steps.detail: The 1 cm criterion is diameter, not depth; a tumor is a solid/nodular lesion with evidence of vertical growth.

steps.prompt: In T1–T2 M0 B0–B1 disease, are nodes N1 or N2?
Patches/plaques involve less than 10% or at least 10% BSA?

steps.detail: Early skin-limited stage group; blood B1 does not automatically mean stage IV.
Patches/plaques involving at least 10% BSA with N0, M0 and B0/B1.
N1/N2 changes can yield IIA even when skin involvement is below 10% BSA.
Tumor-stage skin disease without N3, M1 or B2.
Erythrodermic MF stage group with B0.
Erythrodermic MF stage group with B1.
High blood burden defines this stage group when N3 and M1 are absent.
N3 nodal disease defines IVA2 irrespective of blood category.

steps.prompt: Stage IVB (any T, any N, M1, any B)
steps.detail: Confirmed visceral involvement defines IVB. Treatment requires compartment-specific specialist assessment, not an automatic chemotherapy selection.
